root_cause: The generic production route verifier used Playwright body visibility as a prerequisite. On /prijzen the document, exact release identity and real page content were present, but Playwright repeatedly timed out classifying the body element itself as visible. This blocked the more specific pricing/i18n interaction proof even though body visibility is not the route contract.
prevention_rule: Generic route proof must verify an attached body, non-empty rendered text and at least one genuinely visible top-level content surface. It must not depend on the body element's own actionability box. Functional interaction gates remain separate and mandatory.

invariants: at least one top-level content surface must be genuinely visible

terminal_rule: Protected merge plus exact Netlify SHA and green route + pricing/i18n browser proof required.
